title: Removing genital warts
what: The doctor removes small growths on the genitals. They are caused by the human papillomavirus (HPV). They are removed with laser, radio waves, freezing, or burning.
why: When warts appear on the skin or lining of the genitals.
duration: the procedure usually takes 10 to 30 minutes; healing usually takes 1 to 3 weeks
tell_doctor: If you are or could be pregnant
All your medicines, especially blood thinners
If you had warts before and how they were treated
If you have an immune system disease

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Sometimes swabs and tests are done first. The doctor will give you a list.

prepare.title: Hygiene
prepare.text: Wash in the morning. Do not shave the area unless the doctor asked you to.

bring: Test results, if you have them
steps: You lie on the exam chair
The doctor examines the area and cleans the skin
You get a numbing injection or cream
The warts are removed with the chosen method
The doctor explains how to care for the area at home
feel: The numbing injection is a quick prick
During the procedure, you feel pressure or warmth
Afterward, burning and soreness for a few days
after: Keep the area dry and clean
No sex until it heals. Your doctor will tell you for how long
Your doctor will tell you when to come for a follow-up
Warts can come back. Then they are removed again

faq.a: Yes, the virus spreads through sex. Your partner should also see a doctor.
Yes, there is an HPV vaccine. Your doctor will tell you if it is right for you.

reminders.text: Wart removal tomorrow. Bring a pad and wear loose underwear.
